name: Lisa C. Nashua
office: Pomona Unified School District, Governing Board Member, Trustee Area No. 1

items.text: Lisa C. Nashua is a member of the Pomona Unified School District Board of Education, representing Trustee Area 1, and was elected in 2022. She serves as board president. She is also the executive director of the Los Angeles City College Foundation.

sentences.text: Lisa C. Nashua is a member of the Pomona Unified School District Board of Education, representing Trustee Area 1, and was elected in 2022.
She is also the executive director of the Los Angeles City College Foundation.

items.text: Her campaign website says she supports increasing school safety, expanding technical training programs that lead to living-wage careers, and providing enrichment in the visual and performing arts. As board president, she backed a districtwide student safety initiative for scooter and bicycle education.
